thought.text: Found it: `Options ExecCGI is off in this directory`. Let me add a `<Directory>` block with ExecCGI and restore the catch-all:

reasoning_content:
Found it: "Options ExecCGI is off in this directory". mod_cgid requires `Options +ExecCGI` (or `<Directory>` containing ExecCGI) for CGI execution. Ubuntu's default apache2.conf only allows ExecCGI in /usr/lib/cgi-bin.

Fix: Add the following
```
<Directory /opt/mapserver/run>
  Options +ExecCGI
  AllowOverride None
  Require all granted
</Directory>
```

After that, restore the catch-all.

action.command:
cp /tmp/xplanbox.conf.bak /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf
# restore catch-all (bak already has it) and add Directory ExecCGI
python3 - <<'PY'
p="/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf"
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace(
'''<VirtualHost *:8080>
  ServerName localhost''',
'''<Directory /opt/mapserver/run>
  Options +ExecCGI
  AllowOverride None
  Require all granted
</Directory>
<VirtualHost *:8080>
  ServerName localhost''')
open(p,"w").write(s)
PY
apache2ctl configtest 2>&1 | tail -1 && apache2ctl -k restart >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
curl -s -o /tmp/o2 -w "mapserver via apache: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1"
head -c 120 /tmp/o2; echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root via apache: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/"
